emergency.title: Emergency Alerts
emergency.description: Watch official NWS weather alerts and take matching screens over automatically, then restore normal playback when the alert clears.
emergency.readOnlyNotice: Owner or Administrator access is required to make changes.

prepare.title: Prepare automatic emergency content
prepare.description: Tilecast can generate a fullscreen alert directly from live NWS data. A custom playlist remains optional for organizations with their own response content. This plugin configures automatic responses; a manual Takeover is the separate “show this now” action on Screens, and its defaults live in Settings.

monitor.title: Automated weather alerts
monitor.description: Monitor official active alerts for US states, territories, counties, and forecast zones. Matching rules display live alert details or an optional custom playlist, then restore normal playback when the alert clears.
monitor.safetyTitle: Alert delivery is best-effort, not a life-safety system.
monitor.safetyBody: Keep local emergency procedures and Wireless Emergency Alerts in place. Studio shows poll health so upstream or network failures are visible.
monitor.enabledHint: Disabled by default. A configured rule is required to act.
monitor.coverageHint: Choose a state or territory by name, then monitor the whole state or add specific counties and NWS forecast zones.
monitor.zonesError: Counties and forecast zones could not be loaded from NWS.
monitor.pollHint: A one- to two-minute interval is recommended for most sites.

rules.title: Weather event rules
rules.description: Event names match NWS wording exactly. Leave the field empty to match every event at or above the selected severity and urgency. Tilecast's live fullscreen alert is the default; a ticker bar is the alternative for alerts that should inform without interrupting what is playing.

displayOptions.ticker: Tilecast live NWS alert — ticker bar

rules.displayHint: The built-in display automatically shows the exact NWS event, headline, severity, affected area, instructions, sender, and expiration. A ticker bar shows the same alert text along the bottom and leaves whatever is playing on screen.

placementOptions.push: Push content up — nothing is covered
placementOptions.overlay: Overlay — the bar covers the bottom edge

rules.playlistHint: Only non-empty playlists can be activated.

validation.targetsRequired: Select at least one screen or group.

active.title: Active weather emergencies
active.description: Alerts currently matched to a rule and displaying content.
active.emptyBody: No NWS alerts are currently active.

library.title: Campaigns
library.description: Coordinate immutable content releases across screens and groups. A release reuses the scheduler and never changes what is live until it is published.
library.emptyBody: Create a campaign to coordinate content and destinations in one reviewed release.
library.createDescription: Name the campaign; blocks and destinations come next.

editor.subtitle: {{status}} · draft {{revision}}. Changes remain private until this draft is submitted and published.
editor.archiveBody: Archiving stops its schedules. This cannot be undone.
editor.publishedNotice: The campaign was submitted or published. Review the submission status in Content review.
editor.draftHint: Every field below is part of the next immutable campaign release.
editor.blocksHint: Blocks become ordinary schedules when their release is published.
editor.destinationsHint: Choose the screens or groups that receive this release.
editor.preflightHint: Publication checks referenced content, schedule windows, and destination membership before any schedule changes are committed.
editor.notReady: The campaign cannot be published yet.
editor.releasesHint: Releases are immutable. Restoring one returns it to the draft for review; it never rewrites history.
editor.publicationsHint: Deployment history is separate from the security audit log. Restore creates a draft; rollback creates a new release.

quickPresent.title: Show now
quickPresent.description: Temporarily show content on <destination>{{name}}</destination>. Normal content resumes when this session ends. Emergency Takeovers and AirPlay remain higher priority.

playlistPicker.title: Choose playlist
playlistPicker.description: Select a playlist from your library to show now.

layoutPicker.title: Choose layout
layoutPicker.description: Select a published layout from your library to show now.

assetPicker.title: Choose media or web
assetPicker.description: Select ready media or a website or app from your content library.

airplay.title: Present with AirPlay · {{name}}
airplay.description: Start and monitor a temporary external AirPlay session.
airplay.loadingError: Tilecast could not load the active AirPlay session. Refresh and try again.
airplay.alreadyReported: An AirPlay presentation is already reported on this screen. Stop it before starting another.
airplay.transportHint: Auto uses unicast for 1–4 displays and multicast only when validated.
airplay.audioHintDefault: Primary audio uses the selected or automatically chosen gateway.
airplay.instructions: On iPhone, iPad, or Mac, open Screen Mirroring / AirPlay and choose this receiver.

status.unprepared: AirPlay could not prepare every display

network.dhcpTimeout: The gateway joined Wi-Fi but did not receive an address.
network.routeLost: Ethernet stopped being the default route; Wi-Fi was disconnected.
network.genericFailure: The gateway could not prepare the Presentation Network.

createError.gatewayUnavailable: No eligible Wi-Fi gateway is available for this AirPlay target.

liveStream.title: Live stream · {{name}}
liveStream.description: Ephemeral player output, relayed only while this window is open.
liveStream.leaseRenewError: The live stream lease could not be renewed.
liveStream.startError: The live stream could not be started.
liveStream.connectionEnded: The live stream connection ended unexpectedly.
liveStream.targetLine: Targeting {{target}}. Actual refresh depends on the player and network.
liveStream.privacyNote: This stream is relayed only while this window is open. Frames are never saved to snapshots, live preview, Activity, or backups.
